svg.title: Volume history → boundary tape + working states
svg.desc: Schematic allocation comparison, not measured bar lengths: full stores requested derivative histories throughout the volume at sampled times; boundary stores a per-step boundary tape, terminal physical fields and bounded-volume workspaces. Both retain other inputs and outputs.

g.aria-label: Volume history → boundary tape + working states
Fixed shell thickness: K scales with boundary area, not domain volume.
Time and shot count still multiply storage. Reconstruction adds computation.
StarWave · Implementation schematic, not simulation data
